lines.1: 「So I'm the one knocking after all. Fine.」
lines.5: 「Heh. Someone is trying a trick. Most likely the Princess... Interesting.」
lines.7: 「Take aim. We fire the instant the door opens.」
lines.12: 「Is she being cautious? Knowing her, she should come investigate.」
lines.14: I looked away from the rooftop door.
lines.15: And when I glanced toward the bend in the hall...
lines.20: 「I jumped from the roof and circled around into the hallway.」
lines.22: 「For the record, I did not jump all the way down. I landed on the balcony of a classroom on the top floor.」
lines.27: Otome sprang toward the classroom wall beside her.
lines.29: But the Princess immediately tracked Otome's movement and kept firing.
lines.30: Sensing it, Otome triangle-jumped to the ceiling--
lines.31: Then sprang from the ceiling to the wall by the windows.
lines.32: 「! I can't get a bead on her!」
lines.33: Otome ricocheted from wall to wall at terrifying speed.
lines.34: The motion was so violent that getting close would have swept us up in it.
lines.35: 「Honestly. Could you at least dodge like a human being?」
lines.37: Shots struck the spot where she had been.
lines.38: 「Damn! She can still shoot accurately while bouncing around like that?!」
lines.39: 「So fighting in this narrow corridor puts us at a disadvantage.」
lines.40: 「Princess, retreat! To the roof! This hallway is her hunting ground!」
lines.41: We rushed out onto the roof beneath the night sky.
lines.43: 「Tch. So we are the ones who ended up cornered on the roof.」
lines.44: 「But she can't use those bouncing moves here.」
lines.45: 「We'll shoot when she opens the door.」
lines.46: Together, we trained our sights on the door.
lines.47: 「...No, Tsushima. The door is not what we should be aiming at.」
lines.48: 「If she can jump down from the roof, she can climb up as well. Otome will come up the outside wall.」
lines.49: And the instant we both aimed toward the outer wall--
lines.50: Someone shot into the air with the speed of a launching firework.
lines.51: 「I won't fall for the same trick twice!」
lines.54: No, Princess. Otome could surely shoot straight even from an acrobatic position like that.
lines.55: The Princess would never dodge in time.
lines.56: The moment I thought that, my body started moving.
lines.57: The Princess fired a rapid volley at Otome overhead.
lines.58: But just before the shots struck, Otome fired several rounds at the Princess.
lines.59: The two volleys launched at once and crossed in midair.
